properties.title: LRO LROC WAC Global Morphology Mosaic — 100m (June 2013, v3)
properties.crs: PROJCRS["SimpleCylindrical MOON"] — Equidistant Cylindrical on D_MOON sphere (1737400 m), units: metres. No EPSG/IAU code assigned.
properties.processing:lineage: More than 15,000 WAC UV-VIS images (643 nm) acquired during dedicated nadir-pointing campaigns designed to achieve a standardised solar incidence angle of ~65 deg at the equator: equatorial coverage January 20-28, May 30-June 6, and July 24-31, 2010; north polar coverage April 22-May 19, 2010; south polar coverage August 10-September 19, 2010. Some gores filled with data acquired at other times. LOLA-derived crossover-corrected ephemeris and improved camera pointing applied to each WAC image before mosaicking. Non-polar images map-projected onto the GLD100 (WAC-derived 100 m/pixel DTM); polar images map-projected onto the LOLA shape model (80-90 deg N/S) and the GLD100 (60-80 deg N/S). Mosaicked and processed using ISIS v3 software. Photometric normalisation applied to minimise inter-campaign brightness discontinuities. Version 3 (June 2013) greatly reduced polar/equatorial seam brightness differences present in earlier versions; residual discontinuities remain due to differing seasonal acquisition geometries.
properties.lri:data_use_note: Primary visual basemap for the 3D Cesium viewer. Grayscale morphology at 100 m/pixel provides global context for overlaid resource and chemistry layers.
properties.lri:quality_note: Brightness discontinuities exist between the polar and equatorial mosaic regions due to differing seasonal geometries at the time of acquisition. Not suitable for quantitative photometric analysis across the polar/equatorial boundary.
